description: This file defines the IRuntimeClient interface and the OnDeserializedCallbacks class within the Orleans.Runtime namespace. It specifies the runtime API exposed to both silo and client, including methods for managing requests, responses, and object references, as well as a helper class for deserialization callbacks.

classes.name: OnDeserializedCallbacks
classes.description: Helper class used to invoke IOnDeserialized.OnDeserialized on objects immediately after deserialization.

methods.name: OnDeserializedCallbacks(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the service provider and runtime client.

methods.name: OnDeserialized(IOnDeserialized value)
methods.description: Invokes the OnDeserialized method on the provided object.
